svg.text: तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया । उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्व
tad viddhi praṇipātena paripraśnena sevayā / upadekṣyanti te jñānaṁ jñāninas tattva-darśin
Approach those who have seen the truth — with humility, inquiry, and service — and they will instruct you in knowledge.
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
